issue_request: FHIR-12988 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for DSTU2 asking to remove HL7 v2 DG1-6 Diagnosis Type from Condition.clinicalStatus because condition clinical status codes do not align with v2 Table 0052, while keeping PRB-14.
initial_application: Commit 8da21fd1e4 explicitly referenced #12988 and changed the then-authoritative Condition spreadsheet v2 mapping from "PRB-14 / DG1-6" to "PRB-14". Later source refactors preserved that outcome in source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-13003 is the successor diagnosis-type guidance issue and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 5124ff639b54aac4b8cefc065c38f6866ff74a4b. Later FHIR-51599 was Resolved - No Change and supports treating diagnosis type as contextual relationship/use information rather than a Condition.clinicalStatus mapping.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml already has a v2 mapping of PRB-14 for Condition.clinicalStatus and no DG1-6 mapping.
